hypothesis: Mix frozen win72 and direct-top3 joint probabilities to test complementary podium/order information.
selection: Per target: pooled development loss no worse and top1 hit no worse than top3_allcore, strict gain in at least one; >=3/4 years nonworse loss and >=3/4 nonworse hit in EACH Seoul/Busan. Select minimum pooled development loss, then maximum hit, then candidate name. Otherwise retain top3_allcore. Selection excludes Yeongcheon and boundary ties for A.
temperature: Reuse target/venue CAL temperatures from each component; no post-eval recalibration.
probability: Convex mixture of complete joint distributions on identical support; A/B/C marginals coherent within target. Targets use separately calibrated component distributions.
historical_limit: All years previously exposed across prior studies. Development is reused and reference is descriptive, not pristine holdout.
